newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn closes higher on bullish options play.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn closes higher on bullish options play.

text.p: CBOT corn futures closed higher amid a bullish fund-related play in corn options and the gains held through the close despite a late speculative selloff in the soybean pit, traders said.
Traders said Griffin Trading bought 1,500 December $3.00 calls and sold $2.40 and $2.50 puts at three cents.
The options activity smacked of a strong bullish move. Total arbitrage buying into the corn pit from the options pit was estimated at roughly seven million bushels, the traders said.
Corn found independence, especially in the May contract.
"We tried several times to take out $8 in May beans and $3 in May corn and we failed," said Vic Lespinasse of Dean Witter.
The session high for May was $2.97-3/4 and in the July contract Tenco Inc was a key late seller of four million bushels, they said.
The gains in corn were chalked up despite bearish export data released early Thursday by the U.S. Agriculture Department.
Corn closed two to 3-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with March up 3-1/4 at $2.96.
USDA said during the week ended February 20, U.S. net export sales of corn totaled 502,700 tonnes, below expectations for 700,000 to 900,000 tonnes.
Traders said funds continued to add to their long positions in CBOT grains and soybeans in preparation for a potential spring and/or summer weather scare in the U.S. Midwest.
Tenco Inc, Dean Witter and Merrill Lynch Futures each bought 2.0 million bushels of May, traders said.
ADM Investor Services and Cargill Inc each sold 2.5 million bushels of March, traders said.
Technicians early Thursday said first resistance in the May was at $2.94 per bushel and second resistance was at $2.97. The session high for May was $2.97-3/4.
First support in the May was $2.90-1/2 and second support was at $2.87-1/2. The session low for May was $2.91-1/2.
Corn futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 105,000 contracts, above the 91,566 contracts traded Wednesday.
Corn options volume was estimated at 19,000 contracts, slightly below the 19,360 traded Wednesday.
